meta.purpose: APPROXIMATE source-cloud on-demand pricing, used only for rough comparison vs OCI.
meta.disclaimer: These are blended estimates, not quoted prices. Real on-demand cost varies by region, OS, generation, and discounts. Edit the rates below to tune. For exact figures use the actual cloud bill (cloud-bill mode reads true cost).
meta.method: non-GPU hourly = vCPU x perVcpuHour + memoryGb x perGbHour (by provider). GPU hourly = gpuCount x perGpuHour (by GPU model). Monthly = hourly x 730.
meta.calibration: Per-vCPU/GB rates calibrated to common general-purpose instances (e.g., m5.xlarge/D4s_v5/n2-standard-4 ~ $0.19/hr for 4 vCPU / 16 GB).
